changelog_summary: Maintenance release. Fluidics prime timing adjusted; E-118 detection threshold raised.
Retic channel gain linearisation. Adds E-601 diagnostics detail.
known_issues: Retic CV marginally high above 32 C ambient

changelog_summary: Unified platform build for 400 and 400 Pro. New flagging engine. HL7 v2.5.1 export added.
known_issues: Initial HL7 export omits OBX-14 when LIS profile is 'Generic'

changelog_summary: Adds body fluid mode (Pro). Westgard rule set expanded to 1-3s/2-2s/R-4s. E-307 lot pairing check added.
known_issues: Body fluid background carryover if <3 background cycles run

changelog_summary: Adds W-031 ambient temperature warning. Optics calibration stability improvements.
known_issues: W-031 threshold based on superseded 15-35 C range; see VBB-0052

changelog_summary: QC export scheduling; VeriConnect fleet enrolment via QR; SP-1 LAN handshake v2.
Hotfix for E-302 RFID read reliability. Refactored HL7 timestamp assembly.
known_issues: TIMESTAMP DRIFT: OBR-7 and OBX-14 emitted with drifting offset on 400 Pro; up to 47 min by day 14. See VBI-0091 and VBB-0041

changelog_summary: Intended partial fix for timestamp drift. Withdrawn after 4 days - incomplete correction and introduced E-507 false positives.
Full fix for HL7 timestamp drift (VBI-0091). RTC resync on every result transmission. Adds drift telemetry to VeriConnect.
Extended flagging algorithms for Pro; reagent on-board countdown; support for VeriPrep SP-1 firmware 2.3.x.
known_issues: Requires SP-1 firmware >= 2.3.0 or P-407 raised

changelog_summary: Patch. Fixes rare E-512 during OTA update over slow links.
IVDR labelling data in result header; FHIR R4 result bundle export (beta); revised ambient temperature enforcement 18-32 C.
known_issues: FHIR export beta - not for diagnostic use

changelog_summary: Barcode decoder tuning for low-contrast labels.
known_issues: Does not mitigate P-105 on short-cap tubes

changelog_summary: Adds gripper retry logic and P-112 recovery routine.
known_issues: Retry logic reduces but does not eliminate short-cap jams

changelog_summary: SP-1r2 feed mechanism support; tube height tolerance widened; host protocol v2.
known_issues: r1 units gain partial benefit only

changelog_summary: Liquid level detection improvements for lipaemic samples (P-207).
